notes: Re-reviewed Primary Md 1:5372 after layout repair: HUG width ~79, pad 10/16 symmetric, CENTER/CENTER, radius 0, IBM blue #0f62fe + white label.
Matches extract/computed Carbon primary aesthetic (compact hug, sharp corners, IBM blue).
defects: FC-CANVAS-DRIFT is the whole of this stem's 39.82 (canvas-drift probe 2026-08-09; live snapshot parity/receipts/console-loop/carbon/canvas-drift/LIVE-SNAPSHOT.json, minted off the Desktop Bridge with fileKey GnQnjSNBXtgtd2Ht0Hs1C8 pinned on every call). The live cell 1:5368 is NOT the product of examples/carbon/figma/button.figma.js. The spec binds FOUR paddings on this cell — paddingLeft -> imported/button/root/padding-left (15), paddingRight -> imported/button/root/padding-right/primary (63), paddingTop -> .../padding-top/xs (1.5), paddingBottom -> .../padding-bottom/xs (2) — and the live node binds NONE of them, sitting at a literal, unbound 16/16/2/2. Its boundVariables carry the four stroke weights, maxWidth and minHeight from the same bindings map, so this is not an abort: the node predates the padding bindings. The four variables all exist in the file with the right values (Carbon collection: 15, 63, 1.5, 1.99996), and a self-cleaning live probe (createFrame -> layoutMode HORIZONTAL -> setBoundVariable paddingLeft/paddingRight/maxWidth -> read back -> remove) landed all three with zero exceptions, so the runtime is not refusing them either.

MEASURED CONSEQUENCE: 15 + 45 (label advance) + 63 = 123px against the library render's 124px. The library render's own column profile confirms the split — box x16..139 (124 wide), label glyph ink x33..74, left pad 17 and right pad 65 (Carbon's `.cds--btn` 15px/63px plus the 'B' side bearings). The canvas cell hugs at 79 with a symmetric 18/18. Regenerating this set from the committed script is expected to close most of the 39.82; it was NOT done this round (see the named refusal below).

RETIRED — FC-ABS-SIZE as previously worded ("Carbon's xs button is min-width 100%-of-column, the contract hugs") IS FALSE. Carbon's xs button has no min-width doing that work; it has asymmetric padding, the contract carries it (examples/carbon/contracts/button.contract.json binds padding-left and padding-right.<kind>), and the emitted script compiles it. The contract was never the thing that hugged at 79.

RETIRED — FC-WIDTH-TOKEN as previously worded ("every carbon button gate-shot renders at a fixed 119px harness stage width regardless of Size") measured the CONTRACT RENDER, which is no longer this stem's basis. 119x24 is gate-shots/primary.xs.enabled__default.png; the pinned LIBRARY render orig-shots/primary.xs.enabled__default.png is 124x24, and 124 is Carbon's own geometry, not a stage width.

NAMED REFUSAL — regeneration not performed this round, and the reason is transport, not doubt. The only write path available headlessly is figma_execute, which would carry the whole 230KB script through the conversation in ~29 clientStorage chunks; plugin-context fetch to a local server was PROBED and is blocked ("Failed to fetch" against 127.0.0.1:9228, which is up and answering curl), and `ds-contracts figma push` requires a 6-character pairing code a designer types into the plugin. Regenerating also invalidates this lane's committed shot, framing pin (cellW 79) and scorecard, and the export-back path that would re-mint shots/button-cell.png at 1x is not reachable from here either. Fail-closed with the cause named and the fix localised rather than half-applied.

FC-REF-WRONG-VARIANT (closed by reference audit 2026-08-08): the committed reference was danger--ghost.2xl.enabled — a red GHOST (fill-less) 2xl button whose whole ink is 41x12 — while the canvas cell is the live COMPONENT 1:5368 "Kind=Primary, Size=Xs, State=Default", 79x24, fill #0f62fe (dimensions and fill read from the Desktop Bridge, fileKey GnQnjSNBXtgtd2Ht0Hs1C8). The 75.41% was measuring primary-vs-ghost across two size steps. Reference retargeted to primary.xs.enabled__default.
